story.context: post-fix, same device, after the Fast Pair probe capture
story.what: the current address 4A:02:E4:49:B0:65 (confirmed live by the probe minutes earlier) refused attaches; the widget cycled eight bridge attempts against it, ~20 s apart (a new bridge PID each), re-announcing the same address every time the transient exit reopened the channel
one bluetoothctl reconnect announced the next rotated address 48:DD:7D:82:61:F8; the bridge dialed it and the row came up 10 s later

behavior: The Wave Buds 2 rotate their resolvable private BLE address; the current one is only announced when the Fast Pair Message Stream channel (re)opens.
A transient (exit 1) JBL bridge exit now asks the reader to reopen that channel, so the next bridge start dials the address the earbuds actually answer on.
The five cycles above came back on their own; reconnect alone never needed a manual refresh before or after the fix.
procedure: tools/check output recorded separately; each cycle = bluetoothctl disconnect + connect, mode awaited via omarchy-shell omaphones modeFor with a 60 s budget.
